blocks.name: live_scope
reasons: live scope not enforced for non-live targets

reconnect_storm.recommended_action: Inspect source connectivity and vendor availability before continuing.

heartbeat_missed.recommended_action: Reconnect the stream and verify liveness thresholds for the connector.

gap_irreparable.recommended_action: Treat the stream as degraded and do not assume data continuity.

recovery_exactness_violation.recommended_action: Treat the affected stream as degraded because recovery did not return the full requested window.

invalid_timestamp_detected.recommended_action: Inspect timestamp skew and payload sanity before trusting the affected stream.

exchange_receive_skew_high.recommended_action: Investigate vendor or network latency before trusting event-time ordering.

receive_process_skew_high.recommended_action: Inspect ingestion backpressure or downstream processing lag before trusting timeliness.

schema_drift_detected.recommended_action: Quarantine the affected payloads and inspect vendor schema drift before resuming trust in the stream.

provider_metadata_drift.recommended_action: Inspect authoritative instrument metadata drift and decide whether the affected run must be quarantined or replayed.

marketdata_anomaly_detected.recommended_action: Inspect the affected stream for price or volume anomalies before trusting downstream consumers.

compaction_backlog_high.recommended_action: Compact the affected normalized partitions before trusting long-running live or paper sessions.

compaction_failure_detected.recommended_action: Treat normalized storage as degraded until compaction failures are inspected and cleared.

shadow_semantic_diff.recommended_action: Block promotion until the primary and shadow datasets match semantically.
